synthetic.details: In-memory synthetic units for CI and smoke tests. No download.

polis.details: Polis open-data conversation exports (comments.csv). Civic short-form comments from Computational Democracy Project case studies.
polis.citation: The Computational Democracy Project. Open Polis data. https://github.com/compdemocracy/openData (CC BY 4.0).

gdn_cc.details: Grand Débat National Corpus Clarification (argumentative units). Default split=valid for a smaller download.
gdn_cc.citation: Lequeu et al. (2026). The GDN-CC Dataset. https://huggingface.co/datasets/LequeuISIR/GDN-CC
gdn_cc.license: See Hugging Face dataset card (built on French Licence Ouverte Grand Débat data).

cdcp.details: Cornell eRulemaking Corpus (CDCP): US CFPB Consumer Debt Collection Practices comments.
cdcp.citation: Park, J. & Cardie, C. (2018). A Corpus of eRulemaking User Comments for Measuring Evaluability of Arguments. LREC.
cdcp.license: Research corpus — cite the paper; see authors' terms.

cimt.details: German citizen contributions in mobility planning (CIMT argument-mining corpus).
cimt.citation: Romberg & Escher. CIMT argument mining dataset. https://github.com/juliaromberg/cimt-argument-mining-dataset (CC BY-SA 4.0).

decidim.details: Metadecidim open-data CSV exports (proposals or proposal_comments).
decidim.license: Open data from Decidim instance (check Metadecidim terms).
